Card Q&A.a: No, it means if the total sum of cards in your security stack and the cards in your opponent's security stack is 6 or less.
Card Q&A.q: Does "If the total cards in both players' security stacks is 6 or less" mean 6 or less cards in either me or my opponent's security stacks?

Effect: [All Turns][Once Per Turn] When one of your yellow Digimon becomes suspended, 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -1000 DP until the end of your opponent's turn.

[End of Your Turn][Once Per Turn] If there're 6 or fewer total cards in both players' security stacks, until the end of your opponent's turn, this Tamer is also treated as a 3000 DP Digimon, can't digivolve, and gains ＜Blocker＞.
Security Effect: [Security] Play this card without paying the cost.
